title: Mouseww/anything-analyzer
claim: Mouseww/anything-analyzer — 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built
why_good: The novel part is not the proxy, it is the MCP surface. Instead of a human scrolling hundreds of requests in Charles, the agent queries the capture and runs the reverse-engineering loop. It fuses capture and analysis right as models became able to do the analysis.
value: Sells into integration work — teams that must talk to an API nobody documented: internal system integration, QA against third-party endpoints, migrations, fraud audits. Plausible shape is a paid team tier (shared captures, redaction, audit trail) over a free single-user app, which is roughly how Charles and Proxyman monetize, with the agent loop as the reason to switch.
risk: Fingerprint spoofing plus MITM puts it in gray territory: the same features that speed up debugging also enable scraping past anti-bot defenses, which is the buyer profile enterprise procurement rejects. And mitmproxy or Proxyman bolting on an MCP server is a weekend of work, so the moat is thin.
does: A desktop protocol-analysis workbench — browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint controls — with an MCP server so an AI agent can drive the capture and read the traffic itself.
edge: The novel part is not the proxy, it is the MCP surface. Instead of a human scrolling hundreds of requests in Charles, the agent queries the capture and runs the reverse-engineering loop. It fuses capture and analysis right as models became able to do the analysis.
why_use: One tool that captures traffic from anywhere and lets your agent, not you, work out what the undocumented API expects.
hook: Revolutionize your protocol analysis with Anything Analyzer: the all-in-one toolkit that captures and decodes traffic from any source.

zh.claim: 用 Anything Analyzer 颠覆您的协议分析：全能工具包，捕获并解码来自任何来源的流量。
zh.hook: 用 Anything Analyzer 颠覆您的协议分析：全能工具包，捕获并解码来自任何来源的流量。
zh.does: 桌面端协议分析工作台：浏览器抓包、MITM 代理、JS Hook、指纹控制，外加一个 MCP Server，让 AI Agent 自己驱动抓包并读取流量。
zh.edge: 新意不在代理，而在 MCP 接口。不再是人在 Charles 里翻几百条请求，而是 Agent 自己查询抓包结果、跑逆向分析这一圈。它正好在模型有能力做分析的时点上，把“抓”和“析”合成了一件事。
zh.why_use: 一个工具抓到任何来源的流量，然后让 Agent 而不是你去搞清楚这个没文档的接口要什么。
zh.value: 卖给做对接的人：必须对上一个没人写文档的 API 的团队——内部系统集成、第三方接口的 QA、系统迁移、风控审计。可行形态是免费单机版之上加付费团队版（抓包共享、脱敏、审计日志），大致就是 Charles 和 Proxyman 的赚钱方式，而 Agent 闭环是用户换过来的理由。
zh.risk: 指纹伪装 + MITM 让它处在灰色地带：同一套能力既能加速调试，也能绕过反爬防线，而这正是企业采购最忌讳的画像。另外 mitmproxy 或 Proxyman 加一个 MCP Server 只是一个周末的工作量，护城河很薄。
zh.why_good: 新意不在代理，而在 MCP 接口。不再是人在 Charles 里翻几百条请求，而是 Agent 自己查询抓包结果、跑逆向分析这一圈。它正好在模型有能力做分析的时点上，把“抓”和“析”合成了一件事。

pick_reason: The project offers a comprehensive tool for protocol analysis with AI integration, addressing a clear market need in cybersecurity and development.
